items.title: Private certificate authority support in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now supports private certificate authorities (CAs), so your agents can connect to self-hosted identity providers that use a private CA. This post shows how to issue an IdP certificate with AWS Private CA, configure a credential provider to trust it, rotate the CA, and protect the certificate.
items.creator: Aastha Paul

items.title: How Salesforce is advancing global-scale model serving with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI
items.summary: Learn how Salesforce uses the cross-Region inference router in Amazon SageMaker AI to turn fragmented Regional capacity into reliable model serving. Salesforce adds capacity securely across Regions and accounts while keeping its data residency commitments, and sees per request where each call was served and why.
items.creator: Apoorva Chandra
